# Clip-plane same-call reuse: rejected physical trial triage

Read-only inspection, 2026-10-02. Frozen physical log SHA256 `553a907cc17de4cacb562de03003ffb17cc70786c5b1741e8250097d818baeb9`; use `clip-reuse-trial-physical-summary.json` (the requested snapshot-summary filename does not exist). Trial6400+ was not run by this subagent. No source modifications or builds performed. Candidate rejected for this run; this audit does not identify a proven mechanism.

Root summary: sameELF gateoff/on/off, each2200frames,512 warmed work samples starting1100/3300/5500. Work18.2477667 /19.1370652 /18.4111393ms; candidate+0.8892985 versus first and+0.7259259 versus restored control; controls differ0.1633726ms. All deliver29.94Hz. One runtime-gated ELF avoids between-arm static code-layout differences; gateoff retains bool/branch scaffold, so it is not a compiled pristine control.

## Source side effects

Trial computeClipObjectSpacePlanes reads near/far through const-ref inline getters, clipMargin, fixed guard constants and mvp; writes only eight clipObjectSpacePlanes' normalXYZ/W+distance. All arithmetic is plain scalarfloat; no source COP2 asm, DMA, register-MMIO, cache calls or telemetry reads. activePlaneMaskAABB reads planes/bounds, scans up to8 and builds local integer mask; no writes to input planes, no shared state, no VU0 helper. The first compute completes before mask; when mask fails to promote a bag, second compute has identical source inputs within that call. Ordinary C++ source therefore offers no intended value-changing side effect from repeating it.

Native compiler may materialize the local160-byte planes array through memset and alter COP1 condition/caller-clobbered registers legitimately; correct surrounding compiled C++ cannot depend on their undocumented residual values. Source-level scalar expressions do not establish precise cache/pipeline behavior, instruction timing or undocumented hardware interaction. An ABI/register bug would require direct machine-level evidence or a reproduction; none is established here.

Native inspection provenance: quiet physical ELF is stripped. Current game/bin/vehicle-playground.elf.sym was overwritten by the separate motion build, as root confirmed; .text sizes/hash differ (quiet3048896bytes/395422f3..., currentsym3049344bytes/378ad7a0...). Do not attribute current symbol addresses or render allocation to frozen quiet ELF. A unique12-byte compute-compatible instruction prefix in quiet .text is at0x20a490; raw objdump there shows scalarCOP1 stores and a helper call0x2cf808, consistent with the analogous current-symbol memset prologue. This is pattern-inferred function identification, not archived symbol proof. It cannot explain the regression or justify a VU0 state hypothesis. No quiet sym was archived, and no compiler/register-pressure conclusion is claimed.

## Warm-window observations

`clip-reuse-triage-observations.json` contains source log rows and extraction. Interleave decisions are associated with the PRECEDING FRAMETIME window marker, not a per-decision timestamp; association uncertainty is up to the next50-frame logging interval. For each512-sample region there are5 logged decisions: phase0 interleaved5/plain0; phase1 interleaved2/plain3; phase2 interleaved4/plain1. These are decision-report frequencies, NOT exact fraction of frames rendered in each order. Every report retains heavy44/drawn50/blendAt23. Probe chooses alternating8pairs over16frames and then holds selected order100frames (game_vehicles.gen.cpp ilAccount). Winner requires >4/8 pairwins and1% margin. Automatic interleave can thus change its downstream state while clip gate changes; this is a plausible confound or mediator, not established cause. Both on/off probe timings are also higher in candidate region, so simply seeing more plain decisions is not sufficient to explain the entire effect.

FRAMETIME window means from11 printed rows per region: pre1.579091 /1.579091 /1.580000ms; submit18.245455 /19.139091 /18.409091ms; stall13.464545 /12.568182 /13.302727ms; period33.400ms each. Submit aligns with the higher work; stall drops correspondingly under unchanged field pacing. These coarse rounded window means are NOT the exact512 raw-work means or an independent GPU utilization decomposition. Drain0 in all windows.

Update components remain small/stable: vehicle0.859818 /0.865364 /0.856545ms; physics0.061364 /0.061182 /0.061000; rest0.403636 /0.400909 /0.404091. Vehicle gather0.204273 /0.202909 /0.201545, rig0.081727 /0.082273 /0.080636, input0.023364 /0.023636 /0.024000. No update-side increase remotely comparable to0.73–0.89ms appears in these observed buckets. These are overlapping/nested parents/children and are not summed.

Vehicle log has one identical pose/state across all warm regions: pos0,-74, speed0,yaw0,gear0,rpm800,cam0,pitch1536,FOV60,boom/wanted665,mtx1. No moving/camera acceptance is inferred.

Actual counters selected by their OWN printed frames within each region show fallbacks0, maxFrameBytes2825552,maxBorrowed2151152 throughout; native batches-frames=2/4/6 and ordered splitFrames=1/2/3 remain CONSTANT within each warm region. Thus no warmed fallback/split/batch explosion is visible. Arena resets2/4/6 plateau in their respective regions. Peak1020512/1020512/1040416 and freeKiB10723/10704/10671 are cumulative/high-water or scene-reload state, not per-frame byte counts. The restored control has the largest high-water/lower heap yet faster work than enabled arm; that neither proves nor rules out cache behavior. One extra split per reload appears outside warmed samples, not a measured persistent new split cost.

## Decision

Keep this candidate private/rejected and prioritize the discarded-pick activation census. A source-proven redundant calculation is not automatically a safe performance win on physical PS2. If revisiting, first pin interleave mode separately (plain/interleaved) in matched runtime arms, record exact per-frame order/probe flag without per-bag clocks, repeat fresh boots, archive matching unstripped ELF and compiled-out control. Only then examine packet counts/branch/cache effects. Do not claim a new FPS benefit, register-side-effect cause, or that dynamic interleave alone explains this regression.
